proof_body:
by
  intro K _ n _ _ _ j
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_ne j
  refine ⟨{ carrier := {P | ∀ i, P i j = 0}, add_mem' := ?_, zero_mem' := ?_, smul_mem' := ?_ }, fun P => Iff.rfl, ?_⟩
  · intro a b ha hb i
    simp [ha i, hb i]
  · intro i; rfl
  · intro c x hx i
    have hx' : ∀ i, x i j = 0 := hx
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, hx']
  · refine ⟨Matrix.single k k 1, ?_, Matrix.single k j 1, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      simp [Matrix.single]
      exact fun _ => hk
    · intro h
      have := h k
      rw [Matrix.single_mul_single_same] at this
      simp at this
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nontrivial n] (j : n), ∃ L : Ideal (Matrix n n K), (∀ P : Matrix n n K, P ∈ L ↔ ∀ i, P i j = 0) ∧ ∃ P ∈ L, ∃ Q : Matrix n n K, P * Q ∉ L
